addon:addon.name: Ambiance AmpliPi Binding
addon:addon.description: Whole-house radio, Spotify Connect, announcements and alarm for an Ambiance AmpliPi controller (a stripped AmpliPi derivative). Per-zone volume/mute/power with zone auto-discovery, playback-source switching, station selection, now-playing + album art, a public-address audio sink for Voice.say, and a burglar-siren switch.
